title: Mietspiegel für München 2025: verified test cases

verification.method: Every request in this file was sent with hypothetical flat data to the official server-side calculation (POST https://2025.mietspiegel-muenchen.de/api/backend-service/berechnung) on 2026-09-25. 'officialResponse' is the unmodified response; 'expected' is the same data parsed to numbers.
verification.referenceModel: The formulas in mietspiegel-2025.json#/computation (exact decimals, HALF_UP) reproduce every field of every successful response in this file.

howToUse: Map 'input' to your own model using mietspiegel-2025.json (ids in 'input' are the ids used there; 'calculatorRequest' shows the equivalent official request).
Compare with 'expected' (numbers with 2 decimals) or with 'officialResponse' (German-formatted strings).

'derived' lists intermediate values (year class, area row, Grundpreis, surcharge sum, operating costs, range, deviations) to help debugging; 'monthlyExactUnrounded' is the exact value before HALF_UP rounding.

'apiProbes' use calculatorRequest = apiProbes.baselineRequest with 'overrides' applied (abweichungen overrides are merged into the baseline object; local* arrays mirror their selected* arrays). httpStatus 400 means the official calculator rejects the input.
'grid' holds the 770 Grundpreis verification requests (baseline flat, area = upper bound of each row, Haustyp 'guter Altbau' (+0.36) for year classes 0-2, 'anderer' otherwise).

inputVocabulary.booleans: true = feature present (calculator id 0 'Ja'), false = absent (calculator id 1 'Nein')

cases.description: Small pre-1919 flat in a central good location, simple Altbau, towel radiator, fridge, good floor, net rent
Large 2020 new build in a good (non-central) location with rich equipment, net rent
1962 post-war Wohnblock (einfacher Nachkriegsbau), average location, balcony, simple floor; partially inclusive rent (water, property tax, caretaker, heating/hot water included in the rent)
1972 high-rise, average location, incomplete heating, one living room without floor covering, balcony; justified deviations hot water -0.50 and exterior wall insulation +0.60
1935 good Altbau in the central best location with nearly all surcharges and a specially designed facade (+0.40), net rent
1995 flat, best (non-central) location, many surcharges; an additional justification of +3.00 exceeds the +2.77 span and is capped
2010 flat with fractional area, central average location; partially inclusive rent incl. water, waste disposal and cable TV (a per-flat item, exercises rounding)
Minimum area 20 m2, newest year class 2022-2023, average location, no surcharges, net rent
Maximum area 160 m2, 1900 very simple Altbau, good location, incomplete heating, simple floor; negative deviations hot water -0.70 and no special facade -0.25
Area 80.3 m2 falls into the next higher area row (81-82); 2005 building, central good location, open kitchen, full gross rent (all operating cost items included in the rent)
